audio.title: Helen's Voice Introduction
audio.subtitle: Recorded voice note introducing her background and cybersecurity aspirations
audio.transcript: My name is Helen Hembadoon Sawuan. I'm a young cybersecurity student aspiring to have one of the best careers under cybersecurity learning. I school as well as work. I'm into corporate working systems, and I have a whole lot of things that I would like to achieve as time goes on. I'm from Nigeria, middle belt region of Nigeria, under Benue State. I'm the fourth child out of a family of five, and that's all.

about.sectionSubtitle: Background, aspirations, and dual focus in corporate systems and cyber defense
bioParagraphs: I am an ambitious cybersecurity undergraduate at Miva Open University with a deep focus on enterprise security, information systems, and secure web application development. Simultaneously engaged in academics and corporate workplace operations, I specialize in understanding system architectures, threat surfaces, and digital workflows.

Originating from Benue State in the Middle Belt region of Nigeria, I bring discipline, analytical curiosity, and resilience to every technical challenge. My mission is to build a top-tier career in cybersecurity, protecting modern organizations against evolving threats while engineering resilient, accessible digital tools.

items.title: Responsive Student Portfolio & Academic Management Hub
items.description: Comprehensive responsive multi-page academic portfolio complying with all COS 106 requirements: semantic HTML5, custom CSS styling with Flexbox/Grid, accessible multimedia audio player with local storage, and full interactive task planner.
features: Interactive task management with persistent local storage
Audio voice intro player with .ogg/.mp3 dual source & mute controls
Full client-side form validation with regex pattern matching
Accessible semantic layout with dark/cyber and light mode switcher

items.title: Corporate Network Vulnerability & Port Audit Simulator
items.description: Simulation and auditing platform demonstrating corporate security assessment workflows: subnet scanning, port mapping, identifying exposed service banners, and generating hardening recommendations for enterprise networks.
features: Service banner grabbing & CVE cross-reference lookup
Risk categorization dashboard (Low / Medium / High / Critical)
Audit summary report generation in markdown & JSON formats

items.title: Secure Student Authentication & Verification Portal
items.description: Interactive web security prototype focusing on input sanitization, multi-factor credential simulation, entropy scoring for student passwords, and defensive DOM manipulation against cross-site scripting (XSS).
features: Client-side password entropy evaluator with real-time feedback
Strict input sanitization and regex validation rules
Simulated session token management and automatic expiration
Comprehensive audit log viewer of authentication events
